versions.changelog:
- Pollclaw is now deprecated and has been rebranded as MeetLark.
- Users are advised to use the new coordinate-meeting skill for all scheduling needs.
- Homepage and documentation links updated to point to MeetLark.
- Previous instructions and API references have been removed.

Minor update: User consent documentation removed; instructions now focus on manual poll creation and sharing.

- Removed detailed sections on user consent, calendar/inbox access, and automated distribution.
- Now instructs users to manually specify time slots and distribute participation links.
- Invitation messaging guidance simplified; no channel-specific templates.
- Quick examples and API usage unchanged.

- Added clear user consent requirements for accessing email and calendar data.
- Updated instructions and examples to emphasize explicit user permission before accessing any sensitive information.
- Clarified alternative manual workflows if user declines data access.
- Improved language around poll participation, invitations, and slot suggestions to reflect new consent requirements.
- No changes to API functionality or endpoints.

- Added a template for sending poll invitations, including example text for different channels (email, Slack, WhatsApp).
- Provided guidance on adapting invitation messaging to fit communication channels (brief for Slack/Discord, full for email, concise for WhatsApp).
- No changes to API or core poll creation workflow.
- No changes detected in this version; content remains identical to the previous release.

- Added a friendlier description and branding to emphasize "Doodle for Agents and Humans."
- Updated documentation wording for clarity and broader user appeal.
- Removed the README.md file.

Initial release of Pollclaw, an agent-first poll orchestration tool:

- Create scheduling polls and receive unique admin and participation tokens for managing and sharing polls.
- Distribute participation links directly or via human intermediaries to collect votes.
- Suggest poll slots based on calendar availability, optimizing organizer attendance.
- Supports email verification during poll creation, with auto-verification and clear flows for inbox access/no-access cases.
- View poll results, monitor participation, and close polls once a decision is reached.
- Provides API documentation and examples for seamless integration.
